decision: Prepare a separately registered, one-fit BC experiment with explicit highest-precision inference verification and phase-specific failure receipts, using fresh held-out seeds.
authorization_basis: The user authorized limited BC training and subsequently directed autonomous, independently reviewed continuation; no large-scale RL or online submission is authorized.
disclosure: This would be another fit on the already consumed training data with the same fixed optimizer settings. It is a targeted new-version re-execution after numerical evidence, not a claim that the old failed attempt succeeded or was refunded.
scope: Preserve the original failed checkpoint and all historical evidence; keep default Bot and frozen policies unchanged. Do not automatically reuse previously registered holdout seeds, adjust thresholds after testing, or claim an independent tournament gain.
prerequisites: Implement and synthesize-test phase-specific failure reporting and the highest-precision GPU/CPU check; pre-register exact code, model/data identities, unused evaluation seeds, baseline, metrics, one-fit budget and independent audit before any execution.
interpretation: The controlled sixteen-group result justifies testing this targeted change, but neither proves the old ValueError's unique cause nor establishes model strength. A failed new fit stops without another automatic fit retry.
